5. Derating - Variable resistors covered by this standard are derated linearly from 100 percent at temperatures below 70�C rated dissipation at 70�C to zero dissipation at 100�C. The dissipation is the rated dissipation. Reference should be made to the curve given below, to find out dissipation at other temperatures.
